title: A Fire Upon the Deep
author: Vernor Vinge
summary: Humans awaken an ancient threat that spreads across a galaxy where the laws of thought vary by region. A group of survivors flees to a medieval world of pack-minded creatures while a fleet chases them.
readIf: you want big-idea space opera with inventive alien minds.
skipIf: you prefer realistic near-future settings and quiet character studies.
